title: add GraphQL tool-binding RAG quickstart and step-through tutorial
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: provide a compact, opinionated quickstart that demonstrates using a GraphQL backend as a first-class tool in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) flow. Many customers expose internal product data via GraphQL; this quickstart shows how to bind a GraphQL schema as a typed tool, call it from an agent with structured tool-calling, validate responses, and fall back to a secondary retriever when the schema returns limited results. The guide targets engineers who want a minimal, production-minded example (devcontainer, local runner, smoke CI).

What this PR adds: single-page tutorial (markdown) with step-through exercises, a minimal Node-based GraphQL stub that runs in the devcontainer (schema, resolver docs), an agent example showing typed tool definitions and runtime adapter for GraphQL, a small Playwright CLI smoke test that exercises the end-to-end flow, and docs site navigation entry. Includes code snippets for: tool interface generation (TypeScript types from schema), response validation and structured output assertions, and a recommended error-handling pattern when graphQL returns partial data (use cached embeddings + fallback).

Notes about implementation choices:
- The tool-binding helper focuses on small ergonomics: generate TS types from a GraphQL schema (example uses graphql-codegen pattern), wrap fetch calls with a typed adapter, and ensure the agent receives a normalized JSON payload that the prompt templates expect. This avoids ad-hoc string parsing in the model and keeps schema drift checks at the adapter boundary.
- Fallback strategy: the quickstart demonstrates a two-step RAG pattern: 1) attempt strongly-typed GraphQL queries for canonical fields, 2) if results are sparse, hit the vector retriever (local in-memory index in example) and then synthesize results. Example shows combining both sources into a single structured output for the agent to reason over.

CI and merge: initial CI run had a lint failure; after fixes the full suite passed (unit tests + Playwright smoke test). All checks green, approvals from Samir/Elena/Jules. Merged with method: squash and merge.

Merge metadata: merged_at: 2026-02-24 via squash, merge commit message condensed to the PR title.

Guidance for maintainers: this quickstart is intentionally small; if we expand we should move the GraphQL code into examples/graphql-toolbinding/ to allow additional backends (Hasura, Apollo) and collect community contributions. The Playwright smoke test is kept minimal to avoid flaky network dependencies; it runs the devcontainer-start script and validates the agent returns a structured JSON from the GraphQL-backed call.

Release notes: "Add GraphQL-backed RAG quickstart demonstrating typed tool-binding, devcontainer, and end-to-end smoke CI (useful for teams integrating product data stores via GraphQL)."
